result.brief: 提出 EgoACT 测试时框架，在视频扩散去噪过程中实现自我中心动作迁移，结合速度引导结构锚定与稀疏对应校准，并构建 EgoActionBench 评测基准。
result.reason: Egocentric action transfer via video diffusion denoising for world simulation and robotic data generation; contributes test-time structure anchoring and correspondence calibration in video generation.
